meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

copy.tagline: 对 opencode 进行 CLI、插件、TUI 和数据库的全面质量验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要测试或调试 opencode 的各个组件
copy.tagline_en: QA opencode's CLI, plugins, TUI, and database sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to test or debug opencode components

howto.what: 当用户要求对 opencode 做 QA 或调试时,Claude 会按场景调用配套测试脚本,检查 CLI/终端、HTTP 服务、SSE 事件流、TUI 或查询 SQLite 数据库中的会话,并给出对应参考文档。每个脚本都带 --self-test 自检。
howto.when: 当你说出「opencode qa」「test opencode」等触发词,或要求验证 opencode 的 CLI、HTTP 服务、插件事件等场景时触发。

say.text: 请验证一下 opencode 的 SSE 事件流是否正常。
say.note: 会运行 sse-hook-probe.sh 并检查事件连接。

say.text: 在数据库里按标题查找会话「auth refactor」。
say.note: 调用 db-session-by-name.sh 返回结果。

say.text: 对 TUI 做一次冒烟测试。
say.note: 运行 tui-smoke.sh 在隔离环境验证渲染。

howto.what_en: When asked to QA or debug opencode, Claude maps the request to a tested helper script and reference, checking CLI/terminal, HTTP server, SSE events/hooks, TUI, or sessions in the SQLite DB. Each script ships a --self-test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "opencode qa", "test opencode", or similar keywords, or ask to verify opencode's CLI, HTTP service, plugin events, and other QA scenarios.

say_en.text: Verify opencode's SSE event stream is working.
say_en.note: Runs sse-hook-probe.sh and checks the connection.

say_en.text: Find sessions by title "auth refactor" in the database.

say_en.note: Runs tui-smoke.sh in an isolated sandbox to verify rendering.
